title: Idempotency-first retry framework with region-aware speculative execution
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Problem: Services across Redwood have inconsistent retry/timeout/backoff implementations. This leads to: duplicated user actions (lack of idempotency keys), uneven multi-region failover behavior, noisy spikes during regional blips, and opaque SLO violations. Goal: deliver an idempotency-first retry framework + a region-aware speculative request adapter for SDKs and the runtime. The framework should make it straightforward for services to opt into: (1) idempotency key propagation and enforcement, (2) configurable speculative/parallel retry policies for critical low-latency paths, (3) SLO-driven circuit-breaker and load-shed integration, and (4) deterministic observability (latency/cost/accounting) for hedged attempts. This ticket covers spec, SDK surface, runtime adapter, e2e tests, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Spec document reviewed and approved by Resilience and SDK leads
SDKs (Go, Python, Node) expose a consistent retry DSL: RetryPolicy + IdempotencyKey + SpeculativeStrategy
Runtime adapter can accept speculative requests and dedupe KV-cache/response accounting
Production canary (10% traffic) for two customer-facing routes without SLO regressions
Dashboards show per-token cost and latency broken down by primary vs speculative attempts
Playbook updated; incident runbook entries added for speculative amplification scenarios
